title: Signal policy at rush hour
description: Webster (fixed-time) against pure max-pressure and thresholded max-pressure at J1, rush-hour demand (every flow x1.11). Difference = B - A.

metrics.label: Mean delay, all trips (unfinished: lower bound)
Unserved demand (waiting at entries at the end)
J1 longest approach queue, time average
J2 longest approach queue, time average

result.note: About a dozen metrics are compared at once with unadjusted 95% intervals: one 'significant' among them is expected by chance now and then, so read a single one with care.
